title: Hoshino Ichika — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Rental Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
W-Wait, what...?
For this one, I should...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Done♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What, already?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
G-Get your answers checked!
Ask someone to look at them, and you have to redo any problems that you got wrong!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okie dokie☆
Hey, Honami, Kohane, are you free?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, now's my chance to make progress!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She really wants those chips...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe, we need to match that passion.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Done!
Hona, Kohane! Check mine too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki's finished too. Kusanagi, how many problems do you have left?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Just one... What about you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Same here. We're nearly there, so let's keep going!

rows.Speaker: Emu's Voice
rows.Line: Woohoo! All correct!

rows.Speaker: Saki's Voice
rows.Line: Wh-Whaaat?! I got two of them wrong?!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Good work, everyone. That's it for our study session!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nice work, everybody.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Tough luck, Saki.
You would've come second had it not been for those miscalculations.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Wail*
Ichi and Nene overtook me while I was redoing them.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um, Tenma? I saved some potato chips for you, so don't panic.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Nene, you're some goddess of mercy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And next up is what you've all been waiting for! Ichi's birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She cheered up quickly...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Woohoo! All hands, help out with the cake☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Emu, we don't need that many people for the cake.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'll go get the cake ready.
Can I leave you to deal with the rest?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... What should I—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Ichika, come here!
Just stand in this spot and wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...? Here in the middle of the room?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That's right.
Oh, here it comes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What's this big box? Is there a cake inside...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You'll have to wait and see! Here we go, lights out♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-What's happening?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now, start the countdown!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Roger! T-minus five!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Four!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Three!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Two!

rows.Speaker: Honami & Emu
rows.Line: One!
Zero!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? That voice...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: This cake is for you. Please blow out the candles.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, here I go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Blow*

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Happy birthday to you, Ichika Hoshino!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa! All these petals are so beautiful...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Honami & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I can't believe even you're here, Robo-Nene. Thank you for coming to celebrate with me.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: You are welcome. Thank you for being friends with Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: H-Hey, knock that off...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, it's me that should be saying thanks for that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I'm going to cut the cake. Everyone, please get ready for the toast.

rows.Speaker: Saki, Minori & Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (After such a fun study session, it feels like I'm getting to have two whole parties.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ichika, what do you want to drink?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh... I'll have an orange juice!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika! Did you have fun at your study session and party? You only get one birthday a year, so make the most of it!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hoshino. I don't know if this counts as a gift, but... I wrote up a simplified overview of how to use some equipment that I haven't shown you yet. Feel free to use it.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Hoshino. Also, kudos for your hard work at that study session. You must be terribly busy with your band and your schoolwork, but I'll gladly help you with studying if you ever need a hand.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika. I'm happy to hear you had fun on your birthday with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We made lots of progress on our homework and got to eat snacks and even cake. It was just as fun a day for us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. I've been busy lately and it's been hard to make time to hang out with people, but I'm glad I made it to your party.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ichika, we hope you had a wonderful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika! I'd never been to such a big study session before, and I'm so glad you invited me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: If you're interested, let's do a street performance sometime. See you at school!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ichika! Happy birthday☆ I'm really glad we got to have so much fun on your special day! Let's go out somewhere sometime♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Going out? Yeah, that'd be nice. We've been shopping together before, but we could all go to a zoo or an aquarium.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I will provide information on wildlife when that time comes! Please look forward to it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Happy birthday, Ichika! With you around, I have nothing to fear for Saki! Please continue to look after her along with Shiho and Honami!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: C'mon, Tsukasa... It's not like Ichi and the others are only ever helping me out.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anyway, we're pros now! So we gotta give it everything we got moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. Let's keep doing all we can to share our music with more and more people.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! When the four of us work together, there's nothing we can't overcome.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika, I'm counting on you as always. Have the most wonderful birthday.

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shiho
rows.Line: Happy birthday!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So many people gave me birthday wishes today.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It reminded me that I'm not alone, and I'm surrounded by so many people I can depend on. I feel braver already.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I'm a professional now, so I need to be my own person and keep moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I feel like I'm ready for a brand new start.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for all your birthday wishes today. I hope you keep supporting me.
